issues.description: Helper methods checkUrl(), copyUrl(), and checkCopiedUrl() are marked public but are only used internally within the ClipBoardTests class. They should be marked private to minimize exposure of internal implementation details.

issues.title: Missing clipboard verification after copy operation
issues.description: The testClipboard() method copies the URL but skips the checkCopiedUrl() verification step that validates the clipboard contents match the expected URL. This test previously verified that the copied URL in the clipboard matches the browser's URL bar value, ensuring the copy operation worked correctly. Without this check, the test cannot detect if the copy operation failed or if the clipboard contains incorrect data, allowing clipboard-related bugs to pass undetected.

issues.title: Incorrect UI element verification for light theme selection
issues.description: After selecting light theme mode via Action.SelectLightTheme, the test verifies the wrong UI element by checking darkThemeView instead of lightThemeView. This causes the test to validate dark theme selection state when it should be verifying light theme was properly selected. The bug means the test will fail when light theme is correctly selected (darkThemeView will be '0' not '1'), or pass incorrectly if light theme selection fails but dark theme happens to be selected.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Select Light mode
        navigator.performAction(Action.SelectLightTheme)
        let lightIsSelected = app.buttons[AccessibilityIdentifiers.Settings.Appearance.darkThemeView].value
        XCTAssertEqual(lightIsSelected as? String, "1")

issues.title: Navigation timing issue in settings toggle verification
issues.description: The test taps the 'Done' button before navigating to NewTabScreen, reversing the correct order of operations. The navigator.goto(NewTabScreen) call expects to transition from the settings screen, but 'Done' has already been tapped which dismisses the settings UI. This creates a race condition where the navigation command may fail or behave unpredictably because it's operating on an already-dismissed screen. The correct flow should be navigate first, then tap Done to confirm the navigation completed.

issues.title: Public methods lack required documentation comments
issues.description: The helper methods checkUrl(), copyUrl(), and checkCopiedUrl() were changed from internal to public visibility in this PR. According to AGENTS.md Rule 14, all public API elements must include triple-slash (///) documentation comments describing their purpose, behavior, parameters, and return values. These methods only have single-line comments (// Comment) instead of proper documentation comments (/// Comment). This violates the repository's explicit compliance rules for public APIs.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #31612 - [MTE-5149] - delete auto tests

structured_output.summary:
This PR is mostly test cleanup in the iOS XCUITest suite. It deletes `testCopyLink` from ClipBoardTests (its body was already fully commented out) and `testSetCustomURLAsHome` from HomePageSettingsUITests (already disabled with `XCTSkipIf`), and removes both from the four `.xctestplan` files. The plan edits are clean: no dangling references remain, and the JSON stays valid. It also tweaks `testCheckSystemThemeChanges`, reorders two calls in `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection`, and removes the `checkCopiedUrl()` verification from `testClipboard`.

The main problem is in `testCheckSystemThemeChanges`. The "Select Light mode" assertion was changed to read the dark theme button, so the test will fail deterministically at that step. The PR description also doesn't match the diff: it says a new test was created, but the diff edits an existing test and deletes two others. Two more changes are unexplained (the removed clipboard check and the reordering), and `public` was added to three helpers with no reason.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The Light-theme assertion in `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` now reads `darkThemeView` while still expecting "1", so the test cannot pass and would break CI. The other items are smaller: an unexplained removal of a clipboard check, an undocumented reorder, and a description that doesn't match the diff. The deletions and test-plan edits are safe.

architecture.overview:
The XCUITest suite runs on the app through a `navigator` abstraction. Each `.xctestplan` file (Smoketest, TAESmokeTestPlan, AccessibilityTestPlan, FullFunctionalTestPlan) lists test classes and methods by name, and the test classes in `firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests` drive the app via `BaseTestCase`, `navigator`, and `AccessibilityIdentifiers`. Theme state is read from the accessibility `value` of the buttons that `ThemeOptionView` renders (`lightThemeView`, `darkThemeView`, `automaticThemeView`).

This PR changes that suite in three ways. It removes two test methods and their plan entries, which the plans would otherwise fail to resolve. It edits the theme test so that it checks the wrong button for the Light step. It also removes a clipboard verification step from `testClipboard` and reorders two calls in a homepage test. Nothing under `firefox-ios/Client` changes, so the app behavior under test is untouched.
steps: Entry point: each `.xctestplan` lists tests by `Class/method()`. These are the four plans touched by the PR, and each one must match a method that exists.

Test classes: `ClipBoardTests`, `DisplaySettingTests`, and `HomePageSettingsUITests` run the flows through `navigator.goto`/`performAction` and read element state with `app.buttons[AccessibilityIdentifiers...]`.

Deletions: `ClipBoardTests.testCopyLink` (fully commented body) and `HomePageSettingsUITests.testSetCustomURLAsHome` (already `XCTSkipIf`) are removed from the classes and from every plan that listed them.

Modified theme test: `DisplaySettingTests.testCheckSystemThemeChanges` checks `lightThemeView`/`darkThemeView` values after each `Action.Select*Theme`. The Light step now reads the dark button, which is the broken line.
Reordered flow: `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection` taps Done before `navigator.goto(NewTabScreen)`. This is not described in the PR and needs a justification.

findings.title: Light-theme assertion reads the dark theme button, so the test always fails
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/DisplaySettingsTests.swift`, the "Select Light mode" step of `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` (around lines 53-54) reads `AccessibilityIdentifiers.Settings.Appearance.darkThemeView` but asserts that the Light option is selected (`"1"`). Change the identifier back to `lightThemeView` so the Light assertion checks the Light button. Keep the variable name and the Dark and Automatic steps unchanged. Confirm the identifier mapping against `ThemeOptionView.swift`.

findings.title: Clipboard verification removed from testClipboard without explanation
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift`, `testClipboard` (around line 66-72) no longer calls `checkCopiedUrl()` after `copyUrl()`, which drops the verification that the copied value matches the browser URL. This removal isn't mentioned in the PR description. Either restore the `checkCopiedUrl()` call between `copyUrl()` and `navigator.createNewTab()`, or, if the check is deliberately dropped, remove the helper and document why in the PR description. Keep the existing `#unavailable(iOS 16.0)` gating intact.

findings.title: Reordered Done tap and navigation in testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection is undocumented
findings.body:
The PR moves `app.buttons["Done"].waitAndTap()` ahead of `navigator.goto(NewTabScreen)`. That changes the navigation path in a test that is not listed as changed. The original code navigated away from the Shortcuts settings page before dismissing it. The new order dismisses the page first, then uses the navigator. This may be a real fix, but the PR doesn't say so, and the diff does not show whether the navigator handled the old order. Confirm the new order is needed and explain it in the PR, or revert the swap.

::diff{file="firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/HomePageSettingsUITest.swift" lines="144-160"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/HomePageSettingsUITest.swift`, `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection` (around lines 155-156) now taps `Done` before `navigator.goto(NewTabScreen)`, which the PR description does not mention. Either revert to the previous order (goto first, then Done) with a comment if it was intentional, or keep the new order and add a one-line reason to the PR description, backed by a run on the simulator to confirm the navigator is not confused by the Shortcuts settings page.

findings.title: PR description doesn't match the diff
findings.body: The description says "Created a new test case for testCheckSystemThemeChanges" and "Only the old test case will be deleted". The diff creates no new test method. It edits `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` in place, and it deletes `testCopyLink` and `testSetCustomURLAsHome`, which is more than "the old test case". The TestRail link also changes from `2337487` to `3298823`, and I could not verify that second ID from the repo. Please update the description so reviewers know what was deleted, what was edited, and why the TestRail ID changed.
findings.fixPrompt: Update the PR description for the firefox-ios change in this repo. It currently says a new test case was created for `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` and that only the old test will be deleted. In fact the diff edits that test in place, deletes `ClipBoardTests.testCopyLink` and `HomePageSettingsUITests.testSetCustomURLAsHome`, removes a `checkCopiedUrl()` call from `testClipboard`, and reorders two calls in `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection`. Also explain the TestRail link change from 2337487 to 3298823 and confirm that the new ID is correct. Keep the description factual and list each change.

findings.title: Unnecessary `public` modifiers added to ClipBoardTests helpers
findings.body:
`checkUrl`, `copyUrl`, and `checkCopiedUrl` changed from internal to `public`. `ClipBoardTests` is internal and nothing outside the file calls these helpers, so `public` has no effect other than adding noise. Revert the modifier unless there is a cross-module caller that I could not find.

::diff{file="firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift" lines="8-42"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift`, remove the `public` modifier added to `checkUrl()`, `copyUrl()`, and `checkCopiedUrl()` (around lines 11, 17, and 41). The class is internal and no other file calls these helpers, so restore them to plain `func` declarations to match the rest of the test suite.

findings.title: Deleted tests were dead code, and the test-plan cleanup is consistent
findings.body:
`testCopyLink` had every line of its body commented out, so it passed without checking anything. `testSetCustomURLAsHome` was already gated by `XCTSkipIf(true, ...)` pointing at issue #28117. Removing both is a reasonable cleanup. The four `.xctestplan` edits are also correct. Each removed line sits between other entries, so the JSON stays valid, and a search finds no remaining references to `ClipBoardTests/testCopyLink()` or `testSetCustomURLAsHome`. The `NavigationTest.testCopyLink` entries are a different class and were correctly left alone.
